title: 哨兵客观下线 ODOWN：quorum 投票累计
expected_output:
=== 哨兵客观下线 ODOWN (quorum 投票) 模拟 ===
各哨兵独立探测: {'S1': 'SDOWN', 'S2': 'SDOWN', 'S3': 'alive'}
收到确认下线的哨兵数 (含自身) = 2
votes(2) >= quorum(2) -> 主节点客观下线 ODOWN, 启动故障转移
code:
print("=== 哨兵客观下线 ODOWN (quorum 投票) 模拟 ===")
sentinels = ["S1", "S2", "S3"]
quorum = 2
sdown = {"S1": True, "S2": True, "S3": False}
print("各哨兵独立探测:", {k: ('SDOWN' if v else 'alive') for k, v in sdown.items()})
votes = sum(1 for s in sentinels if sdown[s])
print("收到确认下线的哨兵数 (含自身) =", votes)
if votes >= quorum:
    print("votes(%d) >= quorum(%d) -> 主节点客观下线 ODOWN, 启动故障转移" % (votes, quorum))
else:
    print("votes(%d) < quorum(%d) -> 未达 ODOWN" % (votes, quorum))
